partners.mechanism_chain: CLCN2 (HGNC:2392) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial Ion Transport (GO:0007057); Epithelial Ion Transport (GO:0007057) —LEADS_TO→ Nephronophthisis 13 (MONDO:0014292); SCNN1A (HGNC:10611) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial Ion Transport (GO:0007057); Epithelial Ion Transport (GO:0007057) —LEADS_TO→ Liddle syndrome 3 (MONDO:0029132). Both CLCN2 and SCNN1A are critical components of epithelial ion transport. Mutations in CLCN2 disrupt normal chloride channel function, leading to Nephronophthisis 13. Gain-of-function mutations in SCNN1A enhance sodium reabsorption through the epithelial sodium channel, causing Liddle syndrome 3. Both gene defects converge on the shared pathway of epithelial ion transport, albeit with opposing functional consequences, leading to distinct renal phenotypes.
